readme.section: Missher DSH Output Renderer · 输出外观
readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) · [下载预构建包](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases) · [桌面端](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DeepseekHarness-Desktop) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/issues)

为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四种助手输出布局、可展开的思考内容，以及刷新率同步或新增文字淡入效果。包名为 `@missher/dsh-output-renderer`，源码版本 **1.0.0**。这是可卸载的界面插件，需要已有 DSH 宿主。

`1.0.0` 优化搜索结果处理和来源展开，保留以下输出界面能力：

readme.section: Missher DSH Output Renderer · 输出外观
readme.text:
- **Web 搜索来源卡片**：宿主 `web_search` 的根调用显示来源胶囊，默认折叠；点击展开 3 张来源卡片 + “还有 N 个来源”，可继续展开全部。只使用宿主已记录的 `meta.sources`，不抓取 favicon、不新增搜索后端。宿主没有 `tool.call.toolview` 时保留原生行，`web_fetch` 与 PTC 子调用不走富卡片。
- **简洁对话结论模式**：最终答案步骤完成后只保留最终答复，不显示“查看过程”；思考、普通工具行和同组中间步骤收起，但 **web_search 来源胶囊保留且默认折叠**，点击仍可展开来源网页。运行中仍显示过程，但同一组只保留一个“已思考”行；中断和其他三种布局保持原行为。

readme.section: Missher DSH Output Renderer · 输出外观
readme.text:
1.0.0 更新源码、预构建 `lib` 和 Git 标签；本轮未创建 GitHub Release，也未升级本机插件。最近的正式安装包仍见 [v0.2.3 Release](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/tag/v0.2.3)。0.2.0/0.2.1/0.2.2 的本地安装和更早历史保留在 [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md)。

1.0.0 通过两端类型检查、11 个测试文件的 134 项测试和隔离构建。正常搜索不再读取未使用的原始结果；回退文本超出 4,000 字符显示上限后停止处理后续块；来源展开与收起使用焦点引用，避免为清除焦点状态再渲染一次。真实 DSH 页面及安装状态本轮未复测；历史记录见 [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md)。

下面两张图片保留自0.1.3，展示设置入口和“深想简答”布局；其中“柔和卡片”现已替换。

readme.section: Missher DSH Output Renderer · 输出外观
readme.text: 上图与下图为官方 npm DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5` 真实 Web 页面截图，内容为**隔离 profile 中的合成测试数据**，使用本地确定性适配器产生，不是日常会话、不是真实用户内容，也不是外部模型生成。

| 布局 | 呈现方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 清晰阅读 | 连续单列正文，弱化工具区域的视觉干扰 |
| 简洁对话 | 单列回答；运行中折叠思考且只保留一个“已思考”，最终答案完成后只留结论 |
| 深想简答 | 完整展示过程，末尾答复独立收尾 |
| 任务清单 | 按实际助手步骤编号，显示输出中、输出完成或已停止 |

在 **设置 → 输出外观** 选择布局、14/16 px 字号、舒适/紧凑间距和动效，修改自动保存。四张选项卡片等高排列，窄窗口自动转为单列；可用“重播输出”查看动效。

- 简洁对话在运行中折叠思考且同一组只保留一个“已思考”行；最终答案完成后隐藏同组普通工具、其他步骤和过程，保留搜索来源胶囊，不提供过程回看按钮。其他布局沿用原来的展示方式。工具条目和纯工具组可独立展开/收起。
- Web 搜索来源卡片只在宿主声明 `tool.call.toolview` 时接管根 `web_search`；来源标题/链接按纯文本或 http(s) 外链处理。
- 代码、表格、图片和文件操作复用宿主组件。深想简答不自动摘要或截断正文；任务清单的“输出完成”不表示工具或任务执行成功。
- 刷新率同步使用 `requestAnimationFrame`，没有固定 30/60 fps 上限；新增文字淡入只作用于新到达的文字。遵循系统“减少动态效果”，停止、结束和后台切换会清理缓冲及动画。
- 布局不改变提示词、模型参数或生成速度。实际帧率受硬件、浏览器和 Markdown 复杂度影响，不承诺持续满帧。

推荐使用 [v0.2.3 Release](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/tag/v0.2.3) 的预构建包：[直接下载 tgz](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/download/v0.2.3/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz) · [SHA256](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/download/v0.2.3/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz.sha256)。下列安装流程使用下载的 tgz 文件，不依赖 npm 包名解析。各设备请核对已安装版本与所下载资产。

1. 下载所需版本的 tgz 和校验文件。可运行 `shasum -a 256 -c missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz.sha256` 核对下载字节。
2. 桌面版进入 **插件 → 添加插件**，填入下载文件的完整路径，安装并启用本插件。按宿主提示重新加载后，进入 **设置 → 输出外观**。
3. 在插件管理中关闭本插件的启用开关即可停用；重新打开可启用。停用后恢复宿主原生输出。
4. 在插件管理中选择本插件并点击 **卸载** 可移除。升级请优先使用当前 Missher 桌面端的“更新插件”入口，选择新版 tgz；先备份 profile 配置并保留原版本 tgz。较早宿主若没有更新入口，可按该宿主支持的替换或重新安装流程操作，并保留配置备份；缺少更新按钮不表示插件只支持新宿主。卸载后的偏好保留行为由宿主管理。

Web/自建 profile 使用目标宿主的正式 CLI，替换下面的 profile 和文件路径：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile my-web add /path/to/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz
dsh plugin --profile my-web remove @missher/dsh-output-renderer
```

桌面 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 管理，请使用桌面插件界面。安装 Release 包不需要 Node/pnpm 开发环境或本地源码；不需要额外兼容包。

插件通过宿主 ConfigForm 在 `output-renderer` 命名空间保存布局、动效、间距和字号；默认清晰阅读、新增文字淡入、舒适间距和 14 px。旧 `split`、`timeline`、`compact` 值只读映射为清晰阅读，不在读取时覆写原值。宿主快照不再携带旧 `mode` 字段时以宿主自己的 `writable` 为准；仍然携带时只有 `host` 可写，`memory` 或未知值保持只读。

插件读取已有助手内容用于显示，不创建独立会话库、不改写回复或附件，不调用模型服务，不新增遥测或 API 凭据配置。图片、文件和链接仍使用宿主的访问控制与原生操作。停用或卸载会清理本插件样式和订阅，不删除会话、附件或其他插件设置；插件偏好本身的清理由宿主决定。

| 检查范围 | 证据与限制 |
| --- | --- |

| Missher 社区 alpha.2（`0.2.1-alpha.2`） | 仅完成只读静态对照；本轮未做动态复验，该配套包的聊天折叠动画与本插件强制展开思考的样式交互仍未实测 |

插件依赖 `conversation.chat.node` 的 `assistant-step`、`settings.section`、原生 Markdown 与文件回调，以及聊天 DOM 标记；图片优先使用 Chat 提供的 `renderMessageImages` 闭包，其次使用宿主发布的 `conversation.images.content` Factory，两者都不存在时在正文位置显示明确提示而不是丢图。调用宿主能力前会检查 `slots.inject/register`、`locale.register/bind` 与 `configForms.get` 是否存在，缺失时给出诊断并保持原生输出可见。React、Schemastery 及 DSH 客户端模块由宿主提供；开发 SDK 链接不会进入运行包。升级宿主后需重新核验这些接口，若设置页不出现，检查插件启用状态和宿主加载错误。
完整证据见 [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md)。1.0.0 的 134 项测试、类型检查和隔离构建属于源码/组件级证据，不等同于实际 DSH Web UI 验收。0.2.1 的结论行为有历史用户确认；0.2.3 的搜索默认折叠和结论保留来源未单独实机复测。此前 rc.4 的一次设置保存失败仍未定位根因。

当前独立源码仓库为 [Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer)。克隆已带预构建 lib；开发 SDK 通过 `node scripts/link-harness.mjs /path/to/built-harness` 显式连接已构建的 0.2.0-rc.2 源码，随后用 pnpm 11 安装锁定开发依赖。构建环境要求以该 SDK 的 Node 要求为准。开发链接 `harness-sdk`、工作区 override 和测试适配器均不进入 tgz。

执行 `pnpm typecheck`，并以 `pnpm test --maxWorkers=1` 串行运行测试。`pnpm build` 会写当前副本的 lib，因此维护时须在隔离副本构建；`pnpm pack:bundle` 只打包已准备好的 lib，并拒绝覆盖已有同名包。不要重建日常安装链接指向的目录。
本插件使用 [MIT License](./LICENSE)，包含 DeepSeek Harness 的 workspace-path 辅助代码；原版权声明与完整许可见 [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md) 和 [上游 MIT 原文](./licenses/deepseek-harness-MIT.txt)。反馈请附宿主/插件版本、复现步骤和脱敏错误，不提交真实会话或凭据。

[简体中文](./README.md) · [Prebuilt downloads](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases) · [Desktop app](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DeepseekHarness-Desktop) · [Issues](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/issues)

Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text for DeepSeek Harness. The package is `@missher/dsh-output-renderer`; the source version is **1.0.0**. This removable UI plugin requires an existing DSH host.

`1.0.0` optimizes search-result processing and source expansion while keeping these output-surface features:

- **Web search source cards**: a root `web_search` call shows a source pill that is collapsed by default; click to expand three cards plus "more sources", then expand to all. It reads only persisted `meta.sources`, adds no search backend and fetches no favicons. Hosts without `tool.call.toolview` keep the native row; `web_fetch` and PTC child calls keep the generic presentation.
- **Concise conclusion mode**: after the final answer step settles, Concise conversation keeps only the final answer and no process control. Thinking, ordinary tool rows and other steps in the same group are hidden, but the `web_search` source pill remains available, collapsed by default and expandable on click. While running, the process remains visible with at most one "Thought" row per group; interrupted and the other three layouts keep their previous behavior.

1.0.0 updates the source, prebuilt `lib` and Git tag; this round does not create a GitHub Release or upgrade the local installation. The latest published installer remains the [v0.2.3 Release](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/tag/v0.2.3). The 0.2.0/0.2.1/0.2.2 local installations and earlier history remain in [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md).

1.0.0 passed host/client type checks, 134 tests in 11 files and an isolated build. Valid root searches skip unused raw result content; fallback text stops processing later blocks once it exceeds the 4,000-character display limit. Source expansion uses a focus ref to avoid an extra render just to clear focus state. The actual DSH page and installation were not re-tested this round; see [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md) for historical evidence.

The two screenshots below are retained from 0.1.3 and show the settings entry and process layout. The Soft cards option shown there has since been replaced.

The two screenshots are real Web pages of official npm DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5`. Their content is **synthetic test data produced in an isolated profile by a local deterministic adapter** — not a daily session, not real user content, and not output of an external model.

| Layout | Presentation |
| --- | --- |
| Clear reading | Continuous, single-column text with quiet tool details |
| Concise conversation | Single-column answers; thinking folds while running with one Thought row, and only the conclusion remains after the final answer |
| Deep process, simple reply | The full process followed by a distinct final answer |
| Task checklist | Actual assistant step numbers with running, output-complete or stopped states |

Use **Settings → Output appearance** to choose the layout, 14/16 px text, comfortable/compact spacing and streaming effect. Changes save automatically. Equal-height cards become a single column in a narrow panel; **Replay output** previews the effect.

- Concise conversation folds thinking while running and keeps at most one Thought row per group. After the final answer it hides the same group's ordinary tools and other steps, keeps the search source pill, and provides no process control. Other layouts retain their presentation; individual tools and tool-only groups still fold independently.
- Web search source cards appear only when the host declares `tool.call.toolview`; source titles and links stay plain text or safe http(s) links.
- Code, tables, images and file actions use native host components. The process layout does not summarize or truncate answers. A checklist's output-complete state does not mean that a tool or task succeeded.
- Frame-synchronized output uses `requestAnimationFrame` without a fixed 30/60 fps cap. Fade-in affects only arriving text. Reduced-motion settings are respected, and stopping, finishing or hiding the page clears buffers and animations.
- The plugin does not change prompts, model parameters or generation speed. Actual frame rate depends on hardware, browser load and Markdown complexity; sustained full-refresh performance is not guaranteed.

Use the prebuilt package from the [v0.2.3 Release](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/tag/v0.2.3): [download tgz](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/download/v0.2.3/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz) · [SHA256](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer/releases/download/v0.2.3/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz.sha256). Check the installed version on each device against the downloaded asset. The installation steps below use the downloaded tgz directly and do not depend on npm package-name resolution.

1. Download the chosen tgz and checksum file. Verify with `shasum -a 256 -c missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz.sha256`.
2. In the desktop app, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter the downloaded file's full path, then install and enable the plugin. Follow any reload prompt and open **Settings → Output appearance**.
3. Turn the plugin's enable switch off in plugin management to disable it, or on to enable it again. Disabling restores native output rendering.
4. Choose **Uninstall** on this plugin to remove it. To upgrade, use Update plugin in the current Missher desktop app and choose the new tgz. Back up the profile configuration and retain the old tgz first. If an older host lacks this action, use its supported replacement or reinstall flow and retain the configuration backup. A missing update button does not restrict the plugin to newer hosts; the host controls preference retention on uninstall.

For a Web or custom profile, use the target host's official CLI and replace the profile name and file path:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile my-web add /path/to/missher-dsh-output-renderer-0.2.3.tgz
dsh plugin --profile my-web remove @missher/dsh-output-renderer
```

The Electron-managed `desktop` profile must use desktop plugin management. A Release package needs no Node/pnpm development setup or source checkout. No separate compatibility bundle is required.

The plugin saves layout, motion, spacing and text-size preferences through the host ConfigForm under `output-renderer`. Defaults are clear reading, new-text fade-in, comfortable spacing and 14 px. Legacy `split`, `timeline` and `compact` settings are read as clear reading without rewriting stored values on read. When a host snapshot no longer carries the retired `mode` field, the host's own `writable` flag decides; when the field is present, only `host` may write and `memory` or an unknown value stays read-only.

It reads existing assistant content for display, creates no separate session database, and does not rewrite responses or attachments. It makes no model-service calls and adds no telemetry or API-credential configuration. Native host access controls and actions still handle images, files and links. Disabling or uninstalling removes plugin styles and subscriptions without deleting sessions, attachments or other plugins' settings; the host determines cleanup of this plugin's own preferences.

| Scope | Evidence and limits |
| --- | --- |
| Current source `1.0.0` | Host/client type checks, 134 tests and an isolated build passed; no installation or real DSH page acceptance in this round. |
| Local DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` (historical) | 0.2.3: host/client type checks, 131 tests, isolated build and mock group-DOM conclusion/single-thinking/retained-search checks passed; `tool.call.toolview` and the `turn-process` projection are implemented against this version's contract. Installed in the local `desktop` profile (0.2.3); conclusion behavior was confirmed on 0.2.1; the 0.2.3 collapsed search and retained sources were not separately re-tested in the real page. |
| Installed community `0.2.1-rc.2` | 0.1.4: disclosure, in-flight choice retention, real state/interruption, native tools/images, settings preview/save/refresh/failure rollback, dark narrow layout and disable restoration on isolated synthetic data. |
| Official npm alpha.5 (`0.2.1-alpha.5`, Cordis `4.0.5` / Schemastery `3.18.5`) | 0.1.3 historical evidence: the real Loader checks passed, including and settings, service scenarios covering normal saving, a missing settings service and a missing `configure`, controlled front-en

The renderer uses `conversation.chat.node` / `assistant-step`, `settings.section`, native Markdown and file callbacks, and version-related chat DOM markers. Images prefer the Chat-provided `renderMessageImages` closure and otherwise use the host-published `conversation.images.content` Factory; when neither exists the answer shows an explicit note instead of dropping the picture. Before calling any host face it checks `slots.inject/register`, `locale.register/bind` and `configForms.get`, reports what is missing and leaves native output visible. The host supplies React, Schemastery and DSH client modules; development SDK links are excluded from the runtime package. Recheck these interfaces after host upgrades. If the settings entry is absent, check whether the plugin is enabled and inspect host loading errors.

See [VALIDATION.md](./VALIDATION.md) for dated evidence. The 1.0.0 134 tests, type checks and isolated build are source/component evidence, not actual DSH Web UI acceptance. The 0.2.1 conclusion behavior has historical user confirmation; the 0.2.3 collapsed search and retained sources were not separately re-tested on the actual page. The earlier single settings-save failure on rc.4 remains unexplained.

The authoritative repository is [Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer), which includes prebuilt lib files. For development, run `node scripts/link-harness.mjs /path/to/built-harness` with an explicitly built 0.2.0-rc.2 checkout, then use pnpm 11 to install the locked development dependencies. Follow that SDK's Node requirements. The `harness-sdk` link, workspace overrides and test adapter are excluded from the tgz.

Run `pnpm typecheck` and run tests serially with `pnpm test --maxWorkers=1`. `pnpm build` writes lib in the current copy, so use an isolated development copy. `pnpm pack:bundle` packages the prepared lib files and refuses to overwrite an existing package with the same name. Do not rebuild a directory referenced by a daily installation.
